entries.title: 开发者效率神器：让AI记住你的代码库，少写废话
entries.titleEn: Dev Efficiency: Let AI Remember Your Codebase and Cut the Fluff
entries.text: 写代码时最烦AI忘了之前的上下文，重复解释。这套组合让AI真正懂你的项目：graphify把整个代码库变成可查询的知识图谱，问什么答什么；claude-mem提供跨会话的持久记忆，不用每次重新交代背景；caveman让AI说话更简洁，token消耗直降65%。装上这几个，编码体验丝滑到飞起。
entries.textEn: The most annoying thing when coding is AI forgetting context and making you repeat yourself. This bundle makes AI truly understand your project: graphify turns your entire codebase into a queryable knowledge graph; claude-mem provides persistent cross-session memory; caveman makes AI speak concisely, cutting token usage by 65%. Install these for a silky smooth coding experience.

entries.title: 设计师的AI副驾：从0到1产出��业UI和PPT
entries.titleEn: Design Copilot: From Zero to Professional UI and Slides
entries.text: 设计新手也能做出专业级作品？这套组合帮你实现：ui-ux-pro-max-skill提供设计知识库，配色、字体、布局规则一应俱全；open-design让AI成为设计引擎，直接生成原型、落地页和幻灯片；sunchaokun-ppt-design-skill支持4万+样式，一键输出可编辑的PPTX。装上这几个，设计产出又快又好。
entries.textEn: Can design newbies produce professional work? This bundle makes it happen: ui-ux-pro-max-skill provides a design knowledge base with color, font, layout rules; open-design turns AI into a design engine for prototypes, landing pages, and slides; sunchaokun-ppt-design-skill supports 40,000+ styles and outputs editable PPTX. Install these for fast, high-quality design output.
